info.name: Dupli
info.summary: Find and remove duplicate photos and videos
info.description:
Dupli scans your Nextcloud media library and finds duplicate photos and videos using perceptual hashing algorithms.
## Features
- **Perceptual hash detection** — finds visually similar images even if filenames differ (dHash, pHash, wHash) - **Bulk delete** — delete hundreds of duplicates at once with one click - **Filename filter** — filter duplicate groups by glob pattern (e.g. `IMG*`, `*.jpg`) - **Folder protection rules** — mark folders as protected to prevent accidental deletion - **Keep-from-folder** — when handling protected duplicates, choose which folder to keep - **Select all across pages** — select all duplicate groups across all pages in one click - **Storage savings preview** — see exactly how much storage will be freed before confirming - **Audit log** — full history of all deletions with CSV export - **Inline image preview** — side-by-side thumbnail comparison of duplicate files
## Requirements
- Nextcloud 25 or higher - Python 3 with `imagehash`, `Pillow`, `numpy`, `pymysql` packages
